description: Casts the sidereal (Lahiri) solar-return chart for a target year and returns Tajaka Varshaphal: Muntha, the five office-bearers with Panchavargiya and Harsha Bala, the year lord, the sixteen Tajaka yogas, cited Sahams (Punya first), and Mudda and Patyamsa dashas.

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted

name: calculate_varshaphal
title: Calculate Varshaphal annual chart
